facts.fact: The Ministry of Maternal and Primary Education set up EducMaster, a web platform for school directors and teachers to manage teacher and learner numbers and education data, per the ministry's IT director.
EducMaster is run by the Ministry of Maternal and Primary Education and began in 2023 for the primary certificate (CEP) exams.
An extension of EducMaster built by TICMASTER with UNICEF support was under way, including a school evaluation and grades module and a decision dashboard, still to be finalised.
The document gives no count or share of primary schools entering data on EducMaster.
